name: anlide/hilos-demo-cluster
description: Backend-only multi-node daemon-cluster demo and e2e harness for the Hilos v2 framework

scripts.setup-env: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.cluster.yml --profile cli run --rm cluster-cli sh -c "cd /app && cp -n .env.example .env || true; cp -n tests/.env.example tests/.env || true; ls -l .env tests/.env"
scripts.install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.cluster.yml --profile cli run --rm cluster-cli composer install
scripts.test:db-wait: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.cluster.yml --profile cli run --rm cluster-cli php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.cluster.yml --profile cli run --rm cluster-cli php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite unit
scripts.test:phpunit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.cluster.yml --profile cli run --rm cluster-cli php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml
